<template>
  <el-tag :type="statusType[value]">{{ statusMap[value] || value }}</el-tag>
</template>

<script>
import { statusMap, statusType } from '../constants'

export default {
  name: 'StatusTag',
  props: {
    value: { type: String, default: '' }
  },
  data() {
    return { statusMap, statusType }
  }
}
</script>
